$schema: Each key is a waypoint id from src/content/waypoints.ts (kebab-case of the name). Value: { blurb: string, lines: string[] }.

independence-station.blurb: Independence Station. Everyone here is either leaving or selling something to people who are leaving.
lines: Lane Authority bulletin: the Lane is open. Please do not test this.
Overheard at the dock: 'Five months, they say. They said four last year.'
Lane Authority bulletin: outbound ships must carry a working drive. This is a recommendation.

lunar-debris-ring.blurb: The Lunar Debris Ring. A slow belt of old hulls and older bolts that circles Earth's neighbor like a rumor.
lines: Lane Authority bulletin: debris density is low. 'Low' is a relative term.
Overheard: 'The ring has been here longer than the Lane. It is not impressed by the Lane.'
Lane Authority bulletin: do not salvage the debris. The debris is not salvage.

lagrange-shoals.blurb: The Lagrange Shoals. Tides of drifting gravel pile up where Earth and Luna pull equally and agree on nothing.
lines: Lane Authority bulletin: shoal gravel is moving. Please move around it.
Overheard: 'My uncle hit a shoal in '79. He still wears the dent.'
Lane Authority bulletin: ships stuck on the shoals are asked to wave.

mars-relay.blurb: Mars Relay. A red-lit station with a post office, a chandler, and a long line for both.
lines: Lane Authority bulletin: relay staff are on break. The break is ongoing.
Overheard: 'Everything on Mars is red. Even the coffee. Especially the coffee.'
Lane Authority bulletin: mail for New Willamette will be forwarded when possible.

ceres-approach-spire.blurb: Ceres Approach Spire. A long metal needle, left by the first surveyors, visible for a hundred megaklicks.
lines: Lane Authority bulletin: the Spire marks the route. Do not ask what it marks.
Overheard: 'First to see the Spire gets the good bunk. This has never been tested.'
Lane Authority bulletin: the Spire is not a mooring post. We have asked.

ceres-depot.blurb: Ceres Depot. A busy dwarf-planet stop with fuel, parts, and a notice board of people who owe each other money.
lines: Lane Authority bulletin: depot prices are posted. Haggling is a hobby here.
Overheard: 'Ceres has the best rations on the Lane. This is a low bar.'
Lane Authority bulletin: the depot is out of coffee. Please be patient.

jupiters-eye.blurb: Jupiter's Eye. The Great Red Spot, seen from a safe and respectful distance, like a storm in a very large cup.
lines: Lane Authority bulletin: the Eye has been watching since 1665. Please do not stare back.
Overheard: 'It is bigger than Earth. The ship feels very small today.'
Lane Authority bulletin: flyby photographs are free. The memories are not.

the-belt-crossing.blurb: The Belt Crossing. A broad lane of tumbling rock where ships hire Belters or hold their breath.
lines: Lane Authority bulletin: Belter pilots are available for a fee. They will not discuss the fee.
Overheard: 'A Belter looked at my ship and said nothing. That is the worst review.'
Lane Authority bulletin: the Belt is mostly empty. The rest is the problem.

europa-outpost.blurb: Europa Outpost. A cold station above the ice, warm inside, and proud of its one real window.
lines: Lane Authority bulletin: do not drill the ice. The ice is occupied.
Overheard: 'There is an ocean under us. They say it is friendly. They have not asked it.'
Lane Authority bulletin: the outpost window is open to visitors from noon to one.

saturn-ring-plane.blurb: The Saturn Ring Plane. A bright disk of ice and dust that must be crossed at a careful angle.
lines: Lane Authority bulletin: cross the ring plane at right angles. The ring has opinions.
Overheard: 'It is beautiful until something the size of a house goes by.'
Lane Authority bulletin: ring ice is not for drinking. Several crews learned this.

titan-refinery.blurb: Titan Refinery. An orange-skied station that makes fuel from air and sells everything else at a markup.
lines: Lane Authority bulletin: the refinery smells of orange and regret. This is normal.
Overheard: 'You pay by the liter. The liter is not what it used to be.'
Lane Authority bulletin: the Gate is ahead. Please check your drives.

kuiper-gate.blurb: The Kuiper Gate. A ring of cold metal where the Lane steps across the dark in a single, unceremonious jump.
lines: Lane Authority bulletin: the Gate is working. Please remain seated.
Overheard: 'You will feel nothing. Several people have said this afterward.'
Lane Authority bulletin: gate transit is one-way. Please have your luggage.

oort-beacon.blurb: Oort Beacon. A lonely station at the edge of Proxima's outer shell, with one light and a very long guest book.
lines: Lane Authority bulletin: the beacon is lit. The beacon has always been lit.
Overheard: 'Quiet out here. Quiet enough to hear your own thinking. Not recommended.'
Lane Authority bulletin: guest book entries are reviewed by no one.

proxima-heliopause-shock.blurb: The Proxima Heliopause Shock. A rough edge where Proxima's wind meets the dark, and ships meet a bad idea.
lines: Lane Authority bulletin: shock front is active. Please expect shaking.
Overheard: 'The shock is a wall of wind. Hold on to something that is bolted down.'
Lane Authority bulletin: a ship that passes through the shock is a ship that has passed.

lane-terminus-station.blurb: Lane Terminus Station. The last stop before the colony, with the last store and the first look at the red sun.
lines: Lane Authority bulletin: the colony is close. Please do not arrive in a hurry.
Overheard: 'You can see New Willamette from the east window. It is the small blue one.'
Lane Authority bulletin: terminus rations are at colony prices. We are sorry.

the-flare-belt.blurb: The Flare Belt. A last wall of Proxima's temper, crossed in a single run with a suit on and a prayer ready.
lines: Lane Authority bulletin: flare activity is high. Suits are not optional.
Overheard: 'It is the last stretch. It is also the loudest.'
Lane Authority bulletin: ships that cross the Belt are counted. Ships that do not are also counted.

new-willamette.blurb: New Willamette. A green-blue world under a red sun, with a small town, a large sky, and no store.
lines: Colony bulletin: welcome. Please wipe your boots. We have mud.
Overheard: 'The sky is the wrong color. You get used to it.'
Colony bulletin: new arrivals will be assigned land. The land is also new.
